dedupe_keys.name: soil haiti windrow and bin composting operational data container based sanitation waste treatment temperatures pathogens maturing times volumes and costs 2021 2024

description: SOIL, a Haitian sanitation organisation, runs a container-based sanitation service whose collected waste is treated by composting, and it shares operational data from that treatment on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 describes a workbook with eight tabs: temperatures at six points in six windrow piles, pH, conductivity and E. coli tests, the time each pile took to mature, the number of 20-litre containers emptied onto piles, compost weight produced, water added, monthly service costs with households served and direct and capital costs in US dollars, and a later windrow scale-up. The records run from January 2021 to April 2024 and compare bin and windrow processes. Coverage is SOIL's treatment site in Haiti. Access is free under a CC BY licence. Caveats: this is one operator's experiment with a few piles, a few values were corrected as noted in the file, and cost figures cover only part of 2021 and 2022. It supports planning studies of sanitation infrastructure, such as sizing a composting treatment site and estimating cost per household for container-based sanitation in a city without sewers. No related container-based sanitation record is catalogued.
